en.headline: SHKP sells all 128 Sierra Sea flats offered in latest price list
en.dek: Agents said the New Territories project in Shap Sze Heung found buyers for the full batch by late afternoon on Wednesday, with units priced from about $5.47 million after discounts.
body: Sun Hung Kai Properties has sold all 128 flats offered in the latest price list for its Sierra Sea project in Shap Sze Heung, according to agents.

Sales of the Phase 2C(2) units began at 2pm on Wednesday. By 5.40pm, buyers had been found for the full batch of flats listed at discounted prices ranging from about $5.47 million to $9.87 million, agents said.

The development sits between Sai Kung and Ma On Shan. Ricacorp Properties head of research Derek Chan said developers are expected to continue launching new flats in an orderly manner in the coming weeks, capitalising on current buyer demand.
Earlier rounds of the project had also recorded strong interest, with previous price lists selling out on the day of release. The latest result comes amid ongoing activity in the primary market.

zh.headline: 新地西沙SIERRA SEA最新價單128伙全數沽清
zh.dek: 代理指，十四鄉項目周三下午展開銷售，傍晚前全數售出，折實售價由約547萬至987萬元。
body: 新鴻基地產旗下西沙SIERRA SEA第2C(2)期最新價單的128伙單位已全數售出，代理消息指。
銷售於周三下午2時展開。至下午5時40分，所列單位已找到買家，折實售價由約547萬至987萬元。
項目位於西貢與馬鞍山之間的十四鄉。利嘉閣地產研究部主管陳海潮表示，發展商預期未來數周會有序推出新單位，把握現時買家需求。
項目早前各輪銷售亦錄得強勁反應，過往價單多於推出當日沽清。今次結果反映一手市場持續活躍。
